description.text: To meet the need of students who wish to study SEU's undergraduate or postgraduate programs or improve their Chinese language competence within a limited time, we offer an intensive course of one semester in order to . The course mainly focus on language skills including listening, speaking, reading and writing and is 30 hours per week. Related Courses Chinese Speaking Chinese Listening Chinese Reading & Writing HSK Tutoring Tuition Fee Tuition fee for one semester is CNY 10,000 including all teaching materials, and CNY 9,000 for one extra semester.

duration.text: The Intensive Chinese at Southeast University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1388 USD/per semester ￥ 10000 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graducation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4.Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Be in good health condition, which accords with the Health Standard for International Students stipulated by the China Education Department. 2.Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the Chinese government and regulations of the university. 3.Respect Chinese social customs and habits.
